name: La Vida
notes: 3 photos: a full printed handout menu (bowls/wraps/sandwiches/salads), a TV menu board (breakfast/wraps/sandwiches/salads/matcha bar/smoothies/acai bowls/soups), and a close-up crop of the TV board's matcha/smoothie/acai section (redundant, no new items). Merged overlapping items (Avocado Toast, Perfect Egg, Cali Chicken, Pesto Chicken, Greek Goddess, Kale Caesar, bowls, Hummus w/ veggies). A few overlapping items had conflicting prices between the printed menu and TV board (e.g. Kale Chicken Caesar wrap $16 vs $12, bowls ~$1 lower on the TV board); kept the printed-menu price where both were legible. Omitted tortilla-choice and add-on/protein modifiers.
